info.title: API.SH: Autotrader
info.description: The Autotrader API from API.SH: public Autotrader data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

parameters.name: before

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
An Autotrader (US) dealer: name, address, coordinates, phone, website, rating and review count, makes sold, services, opening hours, home services and photos, plus its cars for sale (25 a page, same listing fields and facets as search), optionally narrowed by make or condition and sorted.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autotrader-dealer

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The dealer id (dealer.id on any listing) or an autotrader.com dealer link (/car-dealers/<city>/<id>/<name>).

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Only this make.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Only used, new or certified cars.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the cars.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (25 cars a page, up to 40 pages).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One car listing with VIN, price, deal rating, specs, features, photos, history summary and dealer. Listings are removed when sold; the example may expire, use an `id` from a search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autotrader-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (or pass `url`, an autotrader.com/cars-for-sale/vehicle/… URL).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The car makes Autotrader lists (code and name, for the make filter of search), or with make, that make's models (code and name, for the model filter) and how many of its cars are for sale.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autotrader-makes

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: A make name or code; leave it out for the list of makes.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
New, used and certified cars for sale in the US, 25 per page, with VIN, year, make, model, trim, price, deal rating, KBB fair price, mileage, specs, photos and the dealer (address, phone, rating, distance). Filter also by body style, fuel, transmission, drive type, exterior color, seller type (dealer or private), single owner, no accidents and clean title. `facets` lists the search's filter groups (make, model, body style, fuel, drive type, colors, features, history, seller type...) with each option's value, label and car count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page (Autotrader serves the first 1,000 results).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/autotrader-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make name (e.g. Toyota, Chevrolet, Mercedes-Benz) or Autotrader make code.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Autotrader model code (see `model_code` in results), e.g. CAMRY, F150PICKUP.

parameters.name: zip
parameters.description: 5-digit ZIP code.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Miles from `zip`; 0 = any distance.

parameters.name: body_style
parameters.description: Comma-separated: convertible, coupe, hatchback, sedan, suv, truck, van, wagon (or a value from the body style group in `facets`).

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: Comma-separated: gasoline, diesel, electric, hybrid, plug_in_hybrid, hydrogen (or a value from `facets`).

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: automatic or manual.

parameters.name: drive_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: awd (AWD/4WD), fwd, rwd.

parameters.name: exterior_color
parameters.description: Comma-separated colors, e.g. black, white, gray, silver, blue, red (values in `facets`).

parameters.name: seller_type
parameters.description: Dealer or private seller listings.

parameters.name: one_owner
parameters.description: true: single-owner cars only.

parameters.name: no_accidents
parameters.description: true: cars with no reported accidents only.

parameters.name: clean_title
parameters.description: true: clean-title cars only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
